scenes.title: 217 investors said no
scenes.say: Two hundred seventeen investors told him no.

scenes.title: Howard Schultz's pitches
scenes.say: Howard Schultz pitched his coffee idea to two hundred forty two people. Most said no.

scenes.label: what he paid to buy Starbucks in 1987
scenes.say: In nineteen eighty seven, he raised three point eight million dollars and bought Starbucks.

scenes.title: One yes can beat 217 no's.
scenes.say: One yes can beat two hundred seventeen no's. Follow for more founder stories.
